name: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited
summary: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited manufactures gearboxes, gear motors, and drive systems. The company operates through three segments: Industry and Automation, Off-Highway Mobility, and Wind. The company's Industry and Automation segment manufactures helical gearboxes, parallel shaft helical gearboxes, helical-bevel gearboxes, worm gearboxes, planetary gearboxes, industrial gear motors, precision planetary gearboxes and gearmotors, inverters, servo drives, and electric motors. The company's Off-Highway Mobility segment manufactures travel drives, slew drives, winch and hoisting drives, transit mixer drives, and high-torque planetary gearboxes for mobile and off-highway equipment.
